title: Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

reports.title: Primera notificación de una brecha de datos personales causada por un ataque ejecutado mediante un agente de IA
Spanish data watchdog publicises first AI agent-linked data breach report
First Agentic AI Data Breach Reported to Spanish Regulator
Primera brecha de datos ejecutada por un agente de inteligencia artificial de forma autónoma

summary:
Spain’s data protection authority, AEPD, has received the first reported personal data breach carried out by an artificial intelligence agent using a well known language model. The attacker’s agent searched generic files, obtained a valid login, then independently found application weaknesses, changed personal data and viewed invoices. The AEPD stressed that the information comes only from the affected organization’s notification and still needs review, and that the AI model or its provider was not necessarily compromised.

This first case does not establish a trend but shows AI supported attacks are becoming real. The agency says organizations should now include AI driven attacks in risk assessments, shorten response times, tighten control of credentials and access, and rely on automated detection and containment alongside human oversight. The notification will be analyzed as part of the regulator’s normal process.
title_en: First data breach executed by an artificial intelligence agent autonomously
